purpose: Track per-agent acceptance coverage without confusing repository skill documentation or orchestrator-run connector calls with verified autonomous agent execution.
global_rules: READ ONLY: no Wix/site/analytics setting or content changes.
A source read by the connected orchestration tools does not prove an individual agent runtime can read it.
Each live finding must include source, exact range, extraction time, metric definition, freshness, limitations, confidence, and evidence link.
Distinguish FACT, HYPOTHESIS, RECOMMENDATION, and UNKNOWN.
Only record a finding as committed after reading back the Registry update and checking GitHub Actions.
Post short material outcomes to #growth-outcomes and technical details to #agent-registry; delivery must be confirmed.
No festival booth revenue may be inferred from Wix online sales.
